notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
[h2]Critical changes[/h2][p]
Big shifts are coming — and they’ll change how you climb through the Classes, how you survive, how you fight, and how you build. This isn’t just balance tuning. This is a fundamental evolution of the Train. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f39f-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]Class Registration Gets Serious[/b] 
No more hopping around between Classes without a pass. 
• Upper airlocks to [b]2nd and 1st Class[/b] now require a matching Class Ticket. 
• You can craft these tickets at the general crafter. 
• The [b]Undercarriage airlock[/b]? That one’s simple: just break the barrier — opening the airlock itself is free. Time to earn your seat in the upper decks. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f480.png"][/img] [b]Limited Lives 2.0 — Redemption & Karma[/b] 
Lives just became a tradable, redeemable resource — and a moral choice. 
• [b]Passenger Chips[/b] can now be used to redeem lives. 
• Anyone can redeem a chip, but the life goes to the chip’s owner or their party. 
• Redeem a stranger’s chip? You gain [b]+3 positive karma[/b]. 
◦ Yep, you can now become the [b]saints of the Train[/b]. 
• And yes, you can still sell chips for solid profit if that’s more your style. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f9ea.png"][/img] [b]3rd Class Economy & Combat Tweaks[/b] 
Things just got more scarce — and more intense — in 3rd Class. 
• [b]Chemicals[/b] are now [i]very rare[/i]. 
• T1 weapons are a bit [b]more expensive[/b] to craft. 
• [b]Pistol and SMG ammo[/b] cost more. 
• [b]Harpoon ammo[/b] now requires chemicals. 
• Base upkeep no longer uses chemicals (good news!). 
• T1 pistol is now the [b]default weapon[/b] in crafting stations. 
• Once you reach 2nd Class, you [b]can’t return to 3rd via airlocks[/b] — only via respawn. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4e6.png"][/img] [b]3rd Class Supply Drops Got an Upgrade[/b] 
They're no longer filled with scraps — this time, you might strike gold. 
• Supply drops now include [b]top-tier mining equipment[/b]. 
• You might even find a [b]T4 hammer[/b] or a [b]legendary drill[/b] in there. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f9f1.png"][/img] [b]Train Wall HP Buff[/b][/p][p]Fortifying just got more meaningful. 
• All train walls now have [b]15,000 HP[/b]. 
• Compartment carriages are now a fast and easy way to build a base: 
           ◦ Just place a foundation and a door. 
• Add reinforcements and they become [b]seriously safe[/b] — unless you’re hit with proper raiding gear. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6aa.png"][/img][b]C8 Exit Airlock Enhancements[/b] 
No more wandering around confused: 
• We’ve added [b]new visual and audio cues[/b] to guide you out of C8. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3af.png"][/img] [b]Max Lives by Class — Risk and Reward[/b] 
Higher Classes now come with higher stakes: 
• [b]3rd Class:[/b] 20 lives 
• [b]2nd Class:[/b] 15 lives 
• [b]1st Class:[/b] 10 lives 
• [b]Conductors:[/b] 10 lives 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6e0-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]Engine Vault Fixes & Rewards[/b] 
Cracking the Vault is now worth it — just be prepared. 
• Vault Card now has [b]25 uses[/b] — check durability. 
• Loot crates now contain a [b]selection of very generous rewards[/b]. 
• [b]Make space[/b] in your inventory before opening — don’t let full bags ruin your haul. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a3.png"][/img] [b]Grenade Damage Balance[/b] 
Booms are still powerful — just not [i]base-wiping[/i] powerful. 
• All grenades now deal [b]less structural damage[/b]. 
• It now takes ~[b]30 T3 grenades[/b] to destroy a T3 wall. 
• [b]T1 demolition charge[/b] got a buff — the rest remain unchanged. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6e1-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]Safe Zones Tweaked[/b] 
A bit safer. A bit cleaner. 
• All safe zone exits now have [b]sliding doors[/b]. 
• Fixed poking/clipping issues on doors and airlocks. 
• A countdown before [b]reapplying safe zone effects[/b] is coming soon. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f383.png"][/img] [b]Pumpkin Patch Fixes[/b] 
Yes. Pumpkins. 
• Grown pumpkins now yield the same amount as those in the botanical carriage. 
• Their yield is [b]Class-specific[/b] — best resources only grow in [b]1st Class[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f9f7.png"][/img] [b]Other Changes Worth Knowing[/b] 
• [b]Batteries[/b] can now be crafted in 3rd Class. 
• [b]Cargo carriages[/b] have more building space (more improvements soon). 
• [b]Mining charges[/b] deal more damage to structures [i]and[/i] players. 
• [b]Base upkeep[/b] doesn’t use chemicals anymore, but will be [b]more expensive[/b] in the future. 
• [b]2nd Class Ticket[/b] is cheaper to craft and doesn’t need chemicals — still takes 5 minutes though. 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f686.png"][/img] [b]A New Era of Strategy, Risk, and Reward[/b] 
This update changes how you play, how you climb, and how you survive. Choose your Class. Redeem or profit. Build or raid.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/f4def0e53915859951633b5f961a2f6e13bb1fb7.png"][/img]

[/p]

notes.title: FRIDAY PUBLIC PLAYTEST
notes.content:
[p]Listen up [img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1182014356599345242.webp?size=44"][/img][/p][p]We've spent the last few days diving into all of your feedback from last weekend's playtest. 
[b]Your comments and ideas have been heard loud and clear![/b]   

We know that you love the train and fighting for conductor, but that a large number of new passengers are struggling to get the hang of core mechanics and how/why they should move forward.  
We tried some fixes for these issues with new breaching mechanics and safe zone turrets (yes... those turrets). 
It is clear, from your feedback, that we need more solid solutions to teaching new players the game, while moving experienced players up the train and giving newer players a chance to get established in the lower classes.  

On top of that, we had some server instability and bugs that disrupted the gameplay for many players.

When you join our playtests, we understand your time is precious and that you want to see your feedback addressed. So we're digging into all your suggestions and working on some more robust solutions to these issues.   
[/p][h3][b]To get this right, we will be putting our weekend playtests on a short pause and opening up our shorter Friday "experimental" playtests to all players. 

Internal Playtest 27th of June from 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM (BST)  [/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This will be temporary, you should [b]expect to see weekend playtests return in July[/b]!    

[i][b]If all goes well, we might even be able to make the jump to true 24hr weekend playtests in late July/early August![/b][/i]   

Your insights, feedback, and ideas are essential to us building [b]Enginefall[/b] together, and we can't wait to see you all back on the train next month.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/f4def0e53915859951633b5f961a2f6e13bb1fb7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: REVOLUTION!
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6a8.png"][/img] [b]Revolution, Explosions, and New Opportunities: A New Era Begins![/b]
Life on the train will never be the same. The foundations of power are shaking, the gears of survival are turning once more, and every passenger now faces a new destiny. Get ready for the most disruptive and ambitious update yet.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f525.png"][/img] Revolution Ignites
Every Contract Station, found in every airlock, now holds the power to ignite a [b]train-wide revolution[/b]. For just [b]2500 credits[/b], you can start the [b]Revolution Contract[/b], becoming the [b]Revolution Leader[/b] and triggering a full-scale standoff.[/p][list][*][p]All passengers are called to arms: [b]join the Revolutionaries[/b] or side with the [b]Conductors[/b] as a [b]Protector[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conductors automatically join the Protectors[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Not ready to pick a side? You can [b]ignore the revolution[/b]... but the train might not ignore you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revolutionaries win[/b] if the Revolution Leader becomes a Conductor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Protectors win[/b] if the Leader runs out of lives.[/p][/*][*][p]Players in each faction are marked with [b]unique icons[/b] next to their nameplates.[/p][/*][/list][p]Only one revolution can happen at a time, but the right one can flip everything on its head.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/f5060601b060d5189c91ce01f24accffbf6a1e98.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/65afa430173dfdc4f042c34e55ae0bf72f2e6cad.png"][/img]

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f527.png"][/img] Crafting Reimagined: Create, Recycle, Master
The crafting system is back, and better:[/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]craft items without needing blueprint copies[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 1 and Tier 2 weapons and basic gear[/b] are craftable with no restrictions (if you know the blueprints).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 3 and Tier 4 weapons[/b] require [b]crafting components[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprints can still be [b]purchased and researched for parts[/b], and research remains item-specific.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Components[/b] are gained by [b]recycling parts[/b] at public or private recyclers.[/p][/*][*][p]Parts also drop naturally from [b]mining activities[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]Your creativity now has the tools it deserves.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/c11b14128049ca529361f302d26baa14179e2408.png"][/img]

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/26a1.png"][/img] Fuel Cores: Powerful, Unstable, Essential
There's a new objective in the race to escape: [b]Fuel Cores[/b].[/p][list][*][p]They’re now the [b]only item required to extract[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]They can only be crafted in the [b]Engine Control Room[/b] using [b]Fuel Core Generators[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]One is [b]free[/b] but [b]slow[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The other is [b]fast[/b], but [b]costs 5 Exotic Isotopes[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fuel Cores are [b]radioactive[/b] and [b]explode after 10 minutes[/b] once picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]30-second warning beep[/b] will alert you before detonation.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]only way to stop the explosion[/b]? Extract them in time.[/p][/*][/list][p]And yes, you can still escape the train during the Enginefall phase without a Fuel Core… if you’re bold enough.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/df3b902dd53ecf41302ca2883364b9cf3b517e57.png"][/img]

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4c8.png"][/img] XP and Battlepass Overhaul
Progression is now fully tied to XP:[/p][list][*][p][b]Every level-up[/b] grants you points to [b]invest in battlepass unlocks[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]XP gain has been [b]rebalanced[/b] to reflect this new system.[/p][/*][/list][p]Every moment matters. Every point counts.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f507.png"][/img] Player Mute
Need some peace? You can now [b]mute individual players[/b] directly from the [b]leaderboard in the game menu[/b]. Stay focused, your way.

[b]Rally your crew, choose your side, and jump in. The revolution awaits.

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/f4def0e53915859951633b5f961a2f6e13bb1fb7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: REDS & BLUES
notes.content:
[h2]Critical changes[/h2]

• [b]Tutorial[/b] ❓
    ◦ Every new player will now go through simple tutorial level, which teaches the basics of the game
    ◦ After completion, players are moved into the Train

• [b]Rare Samples [/b] 💰
    ◦ They can be found in meganodes, nodes and trashnodes with higher rarity in every next Class
    ◦ Engine Control room contains a T3 Rare Sample dispenser which works only if there is a Conductor
    ◦ They can be sold in higher Class for Credits in Sell and Go shop or Syncs at the Dagger terminals in 2nd and 1st Class Compartment undercarriages
    ◦ T1 Rare Sample sells for 10 000 Credits and 5 Syncs, T2 Rare Sample for 20 000 Credits and 10 Syncs and T3 Rare Sample for 35 000 Credits and 15 Syncs
    ◦ Syncs can be used in Sync Shops for T3 blueprints and legendary gear

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44792012/ce7347cb8fd309e323c2e1d780d686480d199714.png[/img]

• [b]Recoil system work[/b] 💥
    ◦ New system that allows for better control of defining spray patterns
    ◦ Recoil recovery will bring your aim back to where the firing started, should feel intuitive.
    ◦ Basic recoil implemented on all weapons, iterations will happen

• [b]Sync leaderboards[/b] 🔁 
    ◦ All Mall areas of Compartment carriages have now a leaderboard which shows the player with most Syncs in their wallet

This build uses train builder, which is deep architectural change essential for future trains. Although it's a historical moment, expect some technical anomalies. Thank you for understanding.

[b]Critical changes[/b]

[b]Remote Demolition charge[/b] 💥

🔹 Currently still with friendly fire turned off, but your enemies can still get a nasty surprise by being oneshot if you catch them in a closing door
🔹 You can toggle both autoclose and safety on individual doors
🔹 Protip: you can manually close the doors also on your friends!

[b]Trash nodes[/b] 🍯 
🔹 For all you undercarriage rats the Train has a surprise: trash nodes, which are mined as nodes in the resource platform

notes.title: RELEASE NOTE
notes.content:
Hydration and nutrition are back online with all the positive and negative effects. Passengers of lower classes will need to get creative with cooking, because hydration gel and nutribars are very expensive. Higher classes can consider cooking a hobby... 🍖 🚰 

Burn rate is set so you have to deal with it two or three times during our playtests, if you don't want the benefits that is! 
State of need bars is remembered after respawn (rounding up to 10s)

Hydration  💧 
🔹 Keeping hydration to 90% will give you a slight heal over time (one tick is 0.5 hp, so the HP bar will update every second tick)
🔹Getting hydration to 0% will give you the same rate, but damage over time. It's not going to kill you, but will create a pressing situation
🔹Someone has a stretchgoal to hook up hydration to sprinting, so let us wish him luck 🤞 

Nutrition  🥩 
🔹 Burns little slower then hydration
🔹 If you keep it above 90% you will get a 15% bonus HP
🔹 Getting nutrition under 50% will lower your max HP to 75, under 25% to 50 HP
🔹 Nutrition will be later used in encumbrance and carry capacity

Part of this rebalance pack is also healing rate of food. Hospitality highly recommends to try them. Especially ear pie is a mighty combat stimulant, because it gives a considerably long heal over time, which with a full hydration and nutrition bar can be a considerable advantage 👂

notes.content:
[b]Greetings players,[/b]

[i]As many of you know we are trying to create something new and unique. We want to turn the world of PVP Survival upside down, and we want to do it with your tireless and unceasing help. We couldn't have started here without your trust and we couldn't get anywhere without your enthusiasm. We are not giants, but surely the cold of northern Europe has hardened us enough.
We truly believe in the strength of the project and we also believe that no one can tell you about it better than our tireless Hospitality Manager. A lovely character, perhaps a little nutty, made that way by life on the train, who will have the honor and pleasure of welcoming you and telling you about this adventure that begins now. Trust him, maybe not too much (this actually as a rule applies on Shirley as well ːsteamhappyː), in short. Have fun.[/i]

[b][Hospitality Manager][/b]

Dear passengers,

Welcome aboard this titanic train, traveling through a wild, post-apocalyptic world. Welcome to Shirley!

You may be wondering what is Shirley?
Shirley is much more than a train, it is a social experiment where people are confined to limited spaces, where trust, betrayal, and rebellion are essential elements of human survival.

Your mission, should you decide to accept it (and believe me, you will want to), is to start your journey from the tail of the train and work your way up to the head, to the coveted locomotive to take control of the train and become the conductor, where you can make your own rules and enforce your own laws. Sounds simple, doesn't it? Think again!

But here's the kicker: You won't be traveling alone on this mad escapade. PvP clashes, alliances as shaky as a house of cards, and heart-pounding moments of chaos are lurking around every corner!

Build, craft, raid, kill and backstab everyone who gets on the train, carriage after carriage, victim after victim.

Alliances will be formed, betrayals will be made, death will be sudden....

But remember, every choice you make has weight, and the train is not just a means of travel; it is a realm unto itself, complete with its own rules, economy and social dynamics.

So will you rule with an iron fist or turn on the party? The train is yours to conquer, and the rules? Well, they're yours and you can bend them!

Welcome to Shirley, where rules are made to be broken
